publicationDecision.scope: Publish five primary-source-reviewed international and early-stage omissions through the guarded workflow; this is editorial authorisation, not clinical approval.

reviewType: AI-assisted primary-source factual review; not clinical approval

entries.name: Ecnoglutide / XW003
entries.stage: China NMPA weight-management approval reported by sponsor
entries.summary: Sciwind reported on 6 March 2026 that China's NMPA approved ecnoglutide injection for chronic weight management in Chinese adults with overweight or obesity. This is a China-specific authorisation, not a UK approval.
entries.ukAuthorisation: The reviewed source establishes a China NMPA approval only; it does not establish UK marketing authorisation.
entries.nhsEngland: No NICE recommendation or NHS England access is established by the reviewed source.
entries.supply: The China approval does not establish lawful UK retail supply, UK launch or pharmacy stock.
entries.limitations: The regulatory claim and trial figures come from the developer's announcement. China authorisation, UK authorisation, NHS access and actual UK supply are separate questions.

additionalEvidence.title: Sciwind ecnoglutide China NMPA approval announcement
additionalEvidence.checkScope: Original sponsor announcement read in full for the China indication and approval boundary; not automatically content-monitored.

additionalEvidence.title: Innovent mazdutide China NMPA approval announcement

entries.name: ASC36 subcutaneous injection
entries.stage: US Phase 1 initiation reported by sponsor
entries.summary: Ascletis reported injectable ASC36 Phase 1 initiation on 10 August 2026. Monthly-to-quarterly dosing is a development objective, not an established regimen.
entries.ukAuthorisation: The reviewed research source does not establish UK marketing authorisation; US IND clearance is not marketing authorisation.
entries.nhsEngland: No NICE recommendation or NHS England access is established by the reviewed evidence.
entries.supply: Clinical development does not establish lawful UK retail supply or pharmacy stock.
entries.limitations: This is separate from oral ASC36. Registry corroboration remains missing, and reported animal findings are not human efficacy evidence.

additionalEvidence.title: Ascletis ASC36 and ASC36_35FDC Phase 1 initiation announcement
additionalEvidence.checkScope: Original sponsor announcement read for initiation, formulation, design and animal-evidence limitations; not automatically content-monitored.

entries.name: ASC36_35FDC subcutaneous combination
entries.stage: US Phase 1 initiation reported by sponsor
entries.summary: Ascletis reported Phase 1 initiation on 10 August 2026 for an investigational monthly injectable co-formulation targeting amylin, GLP-1 and GIP receptors.
entries.ukAuthorisation: The reviewed research source does not establish UK marketing authorisation; US IND clearance is not marketing authorisation.
entries.nhsEngland: No NICE recommendation or NHS England access is established by the reviewed evidence.
entries.supply: Clinical development does not establish lawful UK retail supply or pharmacy stock.
entries.limitations: Combination evidence is distinct from either monotherapy. No completed human efficacy results are established, and registry corroboration remains missing.

additionalEvidence.title: Ascletis ASC36 and ASC36_35FDC Phase 1 initiation announcement
additionalEvidence.checkScope: Original sponsor announcement read for initiation, formulation, design and animal-evidence limitations; not automatically content-monitored.

entries.name: ASC35 subcutaneous injection
entries.summary: The sponsor-submitted registry records a recruiting Phase 1 study of investigational monthly ASC35 Injection B, with an actual 27 August 2026 start, estimated enrolment of 84 and estimated June 2027 completion.
entries.ukAuthorisation: The reviewed research source does not establish UK marketing authorisation.
entries.nhsEngland: No NICE recommendation or NHS England access is established by the reviewed evidence.
entries.supply: Trial participation does not establish lawful UK retail supply or pharmacy stock.
entries.limitations: No results are posted. Ascending-dose cohorts, a tirzepatide comparator and estimated completion are not evidence of efficacy, superiority or completion.

additionalEvidence.title: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT07842640
additionalEvidence.checkScope: Sponsor-submitted registry record read for recruiting status, actual start, estimated enrolment and completion, and absence of posted results; not automatically content-monitored.

discoveryLimitations.currentDatePass: No new UK MHRA, NICE or NHS decision was found in the current-date pass for these five programmes.
discoveryLimitations.internationalScope: China approvals are included to close a global-industry coverage gap and are explicitly not presented as UK authorisation or access.
discoveryLimitations.ascletisRegistryGap: Exact-term ClinicalTrials.gov searches returned no matching ASC36 or ASC36_35FDC record at the earlier review; this is not proof that no record exists.
discoveryLimitations.monitoring: No automatic monitoring source, successful baseline, review renewal or all-green claim is created by this publication.
discoveryLimitations.coverage: The catalogue remains selected and non-exhaustive; these five additions do not establish industry completeness.
